title: Circle of Drakes
summary: Defend the ritual circle against five advancing waves of drakes.
overview: Defend the ritual circle against five advancing waves of drakes.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Intercept drakes early and be ready to reacquire them after their protected march.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Three clients in the circle start the event, unless a GM bypasses that requirement.
Five timed waves contain two, four, four, five and five drakes, with increasingly strong templates.
Engaged drakes resume their march after a 30-second combat interval and briefly resist new aggression.
Sixteen drake kills trigger the scripted objective update and focus spawn.

notes: Approval E353. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
